profile: Name: Omkar Yelsange. Positioning: Data Analyst | Data Engineer | Data & ML Enthusiast.
Location: Pune / Lonavala, Maharashtra, India. Open to relocation across India.
Current role: Data Analyst at Autoline Industries Ltd., June 2026 to present. Work includes collecting live sensor data from physical industrial grinding machines.
Placement: received an offer from Autoline Industries after a GET interview in June 2025.

Internships (three): Data Analyst at Autoline Industries Ltd.; Project Management Intern at Lumax Cornaglia Auto Technologies; Full Stack Developer Intern at Drushya Digital India Pvt. Ltd. Exact dates and responsibilities for the internships are not published on the site.

Education: B.E. Robotics & Automation Engineering, D Y Patil College of Engineering, Akurdi, Pune, 2022-2026, CGPA 8.90/10. HSC (12th): D P Mehta Jr College, Lonavala, 2021-2022, 64.33%. SSC (10th): Adv Bapusaheb Bhonde High School, Lonavala, 2019-2020, 80%.
Target roles: Data Analyst, Data Engineer / Junior Data Engineer, Data Scientist / Junior Data Scientist, Business Intelligence, Data / ML roles.
Journey: started in Robotics & Automation engineering, moved toward software development, then data analytics, data engineering and data + ML.

Skills - Programming: Python, SQL, C++, JavaScript, HTML, CSS. Analytics: Power BI, Excel, DAX, EDA, data cleaning, data visualization, KPI analysis. Data engineering: Databricks, PySpark, AWS S3, AWS Athena, AWS Glue, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, Medallion architecture. Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cloud SQL. AI/ML: machine learning, NLP, generative AI, Gemini API. Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Postman, Vercel, Netlify, Render.

Project GoodCabs Analytics Platform (Data Engineering): end-to-end pipeline turning raw transportation data into analytics-ready datasets. Stack: AWS S3, Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Power BI. Architecture: raw data -> S3 -> Bronze (raw) -> Silver (cleaned) -> Gold (analytics-ready) -> SQL / Power BI.
Project OLA Ride Analytics (Data Analytics): 100K+ booking records, 19 attributes; SQL, Power BI, Excel; covers bookings, revenue, cancellations, customer behaviour, vehicles and payments.
Project Airbnb Market Analysis (Data Analytics): 20,770 listings, 22 attributes; Python, Pandas, NumPy, EDA, visualization; pricing and market trends.
Project Zepto Analytics Dashboard (Business Intelligence): Power BI and SQL dashboard for quick-commerce analytics.
Project M2 Material Data Analysis (Business Intelligence): Excel, Power BI, SQL; data preparation, analysis and dashboarding.
Project AI Chatbot (Machine Learning): Python, NLP, Flask and the Gemini API.
Contact: email omkaryelsange1010@gmail.com; GitHub https://github.com/OmkarYelsange; LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/omkar-yelsange; portfolio https://omkaryelsange.vercel.app.
